If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).

extraction_caveats:
1. The schedule is presented as milestone-based (every 5,000 miles up to 120,000 miles/144 months) rather than a simple repeating interval table. Repeat intervals have been inferred by identifying the pattern of appearances across milestones.
2. Engine oil change interval under standard maintenance: The oil control system dynamically adjusts intervals; a fixed standard interval of 10,000 miles/12 months is the best approximation from the milestone pattern, but the actual interval is determined by the oil control system.
3. Air cleaner filter (engine air filter) standard replacement interval: Explicitly listed at 30k/36mo, 60k/72mo, 90k/108mo, 120k/144mo — every 30,000 miles/36 months.
4. Intelligent Key battery replacement: Appears at 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k — every 15,000 miles/18 months after first replacement at 30k.
5. CVT fluid inspection appears at 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k under standard maintenance. CVT fluid replacement under standard maintenance is not listed; only inspection. Replacement under severe conditions is listed at 60k and 120k.
6. Engine valve clearance has no mileage/time interval specified — inspect only if valve noise increases.
7. Items marked with * (engine drive belts, engine coolant, fuel tank vapor vent system, fuel lines/connections, engine valve clearance) are recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation but the owner need not perform them to maintain emission warranty or manufacturer recall liability.
8. Brake fluid replacement under standard maintenance appears at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k (every 20,000 miles/24 months). Under severe conditions it appears at every milestone from 15k onward.
9. CVT fluid capacity not provided on the pages supplied.
10. Brake fluid specification not fully detailed on supplied pages — references P. 511 for full specification.
11. Engine drive belts first inspected at 40k, then every 10k thereafter (50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k).
12. Several inspection items (brake lines & cables, brake pads & rotors, drive shaft boots, propeller shaft, differential gear oil, transfer fluid, CVT fluid) appear at nearly every 10k milestone starting at 20k, not every 20k as originally recorded.
13. Brake fluid under severe conditions appears at every 5k milestone (15k, 20k, 25k, 30k, etc.), so the severe interval is approximately 5,000 miles/6 months.
